findings.summary: An unsigned developer build: no code signing or notarization. Only the macOS arm64 executable was run; the Linux and Windows archives were checked against SHA256SUMS, and their builds ran the tests on those platforms in the release workflow.

body.summary: Candidate tally 0.1.0 at fa33ea0: the draft's three archives match SHA256SUMS; the macOS arm64 executable counts lines, words and characters of standard input and files, including text outside ASCII, prints the JSON form with --json, and reports an unreadable file on standard error with exit code 1. It carries TALLY-01 and TALLY-02, both accepted, and the release workflow's tests passed on Linux, macOS and Windows.
